newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African c.bank likely to delay M3, credit data.
newsitem.headline: S.African c.bank likely to delay M3, credit data.

text.p: The South African Reserve Bank said on Wednesday it was likely to delay the release of April money supply and credit extension data which was originally scheduled for 1500GMT.
"We'll decide in about three quarters of an hour. It is likely (to be delayed)," a central bank spokesman told Reuters.

The credit number, was forecast by economists to have risen to 16.40 percent from 15.96 percent year-on-year, while money supply was also seen higher at 16.70 percent year-on-year from a preliminary 16.39 percent.
